title: `additionalProperties`
description: Controls whether an object accepts keys that are not declared in its properties map.
question: Is each object's additional-properties policy preserved at the capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tool schemas declaring additionalProperties.
known_issues: Two framework adapters could not be measured against 2026-07-28, so missing evidence is not a support result.
why: Object openness is part of the parameter contract. Changing it can alter which calls validate before they reach the server.

notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): toolsFromDefinitions wraps each inputSchema as jsonSchema({...inputSchema, properties: inputSchema.properties ?? {}, additionalProperties: false}), so every tool's root object is closed to undeclared keys although the server set no policy there. Nested objects keep the server's policy.
